verdict.rationale: Pulumi Neo is explicitly framed as an agentic automation that 'handles dependencies, executes changes, and monitors outcomes automatically' from plain-English requests, and the Automation API lets developers embed Pulumi's engine into background services that can create/update/destroy infrastructure programmatically without CLI interaction. These are first-party docs only, with Neo appearing to be an early/enterprise-controlled feature and Pulumi's general workflow still emphasizing preview/approval steps rather than fully unattended runs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Neo running unattended in production, details on scheduling/triggers for autonomous runs, and clarity on how much human-in-the-loop review is required before changes are applied.
